The City Council reconvened The City Council discussed additional topics to be considered for
at 12:49 p.m. "Deep-Dive" presentations by City staff, including implementation of
  a Community Benefit Agreement policy as part of future
  development agreement approvals, retention strategies for keeping

   affordable housing in the City, review of strategies to address
  homelessness (shelters, interim housing, etc.), review and
r  consideration of community policing/de-escalation/training policies
  for the Police Department; and strategies to address drugs and gun
i  violence occurring in the City (review of Police Department staffing
  levels, use of Park Ranger/Park Safety Specialist positions).

  Following discussion, the City Council conceptually discussed the
  need for a follow-up workshop focused on the topic of how the City
  Council can work better as a body. Mark Jomsky, City Clerk, stated
  that a possible date for such a special workshop meeting could take
  place on Monday, July 31, 2023 and could occur at the Rose Bowl
  stadium as an alternative venue.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 1:59 p.m.
